about: The seed list of teaching repertoire (E28; E2 item 5): public-domain works a teacher reaches for first, each with the lesson concepts it is known for. A proposal source only, by the reviewer's ruling on E28: reputation puts a work on a shortlist, and only measured presence on a file admits anything to a claim. The finder's prompts name these works as examples of the right kind (finder.py, seed_works), the excerpt proposer offers the catalogue's editions of them first within each pass (excerpt_proposer.py, seeded_parents), and the app reads them as external recommendations whose demands are estimates, never measured (app/src/curriculum/candidates.ts, recommendationsFromSeed). Nothing here is notation, and nothing here admits, places or approves anything. 'concepts' are ids from content/curriculum/concepts.json; 'catalogue' lists the composition keys the build writes for the catalogue's editions of the work (provenance.composition; empty where the catalogue holds none, or where its only editions are generated exercises, which are not works); 'died' is the composer's death year, so the composition is public domain where copyright runs for the author's life and seventy years; 'confidence' is how settled the work's reputation for those concepts is, a proposer's estimate, unverified as music.
